params.body:
## What changed

**Header-cell buttons moved to the toolbar** (open point of PR 381). On dealers, roles, locations, options, extra options, requirements, useful links, release notes, the simple lists, merchants and exports, "+ Toevoegen" (and on dealers the Excel export) sat inside the last `<th>`. It now stands in the `ui-list-toolbar` row, right of Sorteer op and Filteren: Excel as an icon button (`ui-button--icon`, tooltip and aria-label), Toevoegen as primary. The header cell is plain. The two lists inside a sheet (users of a dealer, values of an option) get their own `ui-list-toolbar` above the table. The phone rule that showed the header cell as a full-width button is removed; the toolbar stacking rules of PR 381 apply (on dealers: sort and filter share a row, Meekijklog with the Excel icon on the next, Toevoegen full width).

**Dealers list, for an administrator with 500+ dealers**
- One search box in the toolbar (name, e-mail, city), filtering on typing through the same `ui-autofilter` form; the form now wraps the toolbar. `Search` has no type for one value over three columns and is not touched: `Dealer::zoek` handles the box and remembers it in the session the way the column filters are remembered (a sort click or pagination keeps it). The three column filters it covers left the filter row; Filteren holds the rest.
- The Meekijklog button moved from the page head (where it collided with the notification bell) into the toolbar next to Toevoegen, as a secondary button.
- "Inloggen als" on the row: with exactly one dealer administrator (`Delegation::dealerAdmins`) the amber user button logs in as that user; with several it opens a `ui-menu` of names; with none there is no button. Same gates as the user list: an administrator, not while delegating, and the dealer's consent. `DealerController@index` eager-loads `users.role` so this costs one query per page.

## Tests
`ListPageHeadersTest`: no column header on the eleven list pages holds a button or link and Toevoegen is in the toolbar; the two sheet lists carry a toolbar; the dealer search box filters and is remembered. `DelegationTest`: one admin is a direct link, two are a menu, none is nothing; hidden without consent and while delegating.

Filter `ListPageHeaders|Dealer|Delegat|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: 195 tests, 1 failure unrelated to this change (`IntegrationSmokeTest::test_removebg_prefers_the_dealer_key_and_reports_a_refused_key`, also failing on its own on this local database; the test and the code it covers are not touched here).

## Still open
- The users list inside the dealer sheet is a plain table without any filter; a search box there needs a filter mechanism the tab does not have yet.
- The rest of the open point (one component for toolbar and filter row, Bootstrap dropdowns on the offer lists, duplicate label/placeholder on the phone filter panel) stands.

Screenshots (1440 and 390): `.playwright-mcp/toolbar-buttons/dealers-1440-after.png`, `.playwright-mcp/toolbar-buttons/dealers-390-after.png`.
params.title: List actions live in the toolbar, and a dealer row can be entered directly
